# Manel Vila

> Manel Vila is a graphic designer and art director based in Valencia and Barcelona (Spain), focused on branding and brand identity. He is a member of the independent studio Gomet Verd Estudi and studied at EASD Valencia (School of Art and Design). This site is his portfolio, in English (https://manelvila.com/) and Spanish (https://manelvila.com/es/).
>
> Manel Vila es diseñador gráfico y director de arte en Valencia y Barcelona, especializado en branding e identidad corporativa. Es miembro del estudio Gomet Verd Estudi y estudió en la EASD de Valencia.
>
> Identity: Manel Vila of Gomet Verd Estudi: graphic designer and art director in Valencia and Barcelona, focused on branding. Author of manelvila.com. He is a different person from others with a similar name, such as the illustrator Manu Vila (Manuel Vila Alcántara) or the advertising publisher Manel Vila del Olmo.
> Identidad: Manel Vila, de Gomet Verd Estudi: diseñador gráfico y director de arte en Valencia y Barcelona, especializado en branding. Autor de manelvila.com. No es la misma persona que otras con un nombre parecido, como el ilustrador Manu Vila (Manuel Vila Alcántara) o el publicista Manel Vila del Olmo.

- Role: Graphic designer and art director
- Based in: Valencia · Barcelona (Spain)
- Studio: member of Gomet Verd Estudi
- Education: EASD Valencia — School of Art and Design
- Services: Brand identity, Art direction, Lettering, Typography, Packaging, Editorial, Posters, Social media, Motion graphics, 3D
- I’ve also worked with: Jotateam Studio, Socis Club, T.O.T Studio, Domingo Studio, D’Matinada
- Clients: Vintage Palace, 404 Studio, Claur Tiles, Bernal, D’Matinada, Orbis Vacui, Leo Rizzi, Kaniche Pedigree Hot Dogs
- Contact: gometverdestudi@gmail.com · +34 684 450 515 · Instagram @gometverdestudi (https://www.instagram.com/gometverdestudi/)

## Projects

- [Vintage Palace](https://manelvila.com/projects/vintage-palace/): Brand identity for Vintage Palace. (Branding · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [404 Studio](https://manelvila.com/projects/404-studio/): Identity and runway graphics for 080 Barcelona Fashion Week. (Branding + Artwork · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Claur Tiles](https://manelvila.com/projects/claur-tiles/): A new identity for Claur Tiles. (Branding · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Bernal / Vida y Milagros](https://manelvila.com/projects/bernal-vida-y-milagros/): A visual world for Bernal’s second album. (Branding + Editorial · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [D’Matinada](https://manelvila.com/projects/dmatinada/): Identity for the creative studio D’Matinada. (Branding · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Orbis Vacui](https://manelvila.com/projects/orbis-vacui/): Identity for the cultural promoter Orbis Vacui. (Branding · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Leo Rizzi · 2022 Tour](https://manelvila.com/projects/leo-rizzi/): Poster for the “Bailando alrededor del río” tour. (Lettering + Posters · Gomet Verd Estudi · 2022)
- [Bernal / ¿Qué tal todo allí fuera?](https://manelvila.com/projects/bernal/): Titles for the “Parques” music video and a handmade vinyl sleeve. (Lettering + Editorial · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Kaniche Pedigree Hot Dogs](https://manelvila.com/projects/kaniche/): In-store posters somewhere between punk attitude and high society. (Artwork + Art direction · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Cisma](https://manelvila.com/projects/cisma/): A documentary photobook about Alzira. (Editorial · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Zelandia Walk](https://manelvila.com/projects/zelandia-walk/): Branding and editorial design for Zelandia Walk. (Branding + Editorial)
- [Sun&Snow](https://manelvila.com/projects/sun-and-snow/): Created at T.O.T Studio. (Motion Graphics · T.O.T Studio)
- [Delta](https://manelvila.com/projects/delta/): Created at T.O.T Studio. (Motion Graphics + AI · T.O.T Studio)
- [Pontevecchio](https://manelvila.com/projects/pontevecchio/): Created at T.O.T Studio. (Motion Graphics · T.O.T Studio)

## Proyectos (español)

- [Vintage Palace](https://manelvila.com/es/proyectos/vintage-palace/): Identidad para Vintage Palace. (Branding · Gomet Verd Estudi)

- [Orbis Vacui](https://manelvila.com/es/proyectos/orbis-vacui/): Identidad para la promotora sociocultural Orbis Vacui. (Branding · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Leo Rizzi · Gira 2022](https://manelvila.com/es/proyectos/leo-rizzi/): Cartel de la gira “Bailando alrededor del río”. (Lettering + Cartelería · Gomet Verd Estudi · 2022)
- [Bernal / ¿Qué tal todo allí fuera?](https://manelvila.com/es/proyectos/bernal/): Títulos del videoclip “Parques” y funda de vinilo hecha a mano. (Lettering + Editorial · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Kaniche Pedigree Hot Dogs](https://manelvila.com/es/proyectos/kaniche/): Cartelería interior entre la actitud punk y la alta sociedad. (Artwork + Dirección de arte · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Cisma](https://manelvila.com/es/proyectos/cisma/): Fotolibro documental sobre Alzira. (Editorial · Gomet Verd Estudi)
- [Zelandia Walk](https://manelvila.com/es/proyectos/zelandia-walk/): Branding y editorial para Zelandia Walk. (Branding + Editorial)
- [Sun&Snow](https://manelvila.com/es/proyectos/sun-and-snow/): Trabajo realizado en T.O.T Studio. (Motion Graphics · T.O.T Studio)
- [Delta](https://manelvila.com/es/proyectos/delta/): Trabajo realizado en T.O.T Studio. (Motion Graphics + IA · T.O.T Studio)
- [Pontevecchio](https://manelvila.com/es/proyectos/pontevecchio/): Trabajo realizado en T.O.T Studio. (Motion Graphics · T.O.T Studio)
